title: Worker stop notices carry the worker's state, and worker reports stay short
notes: Retro 2026-11-28: in the last main session 556 worker messages took about 789 KB, about 30% of the transcript, across 9 compactions. Every stop notice ('has finished its turn', 'stopped without sending you a report') ends with 'pane list shows where every worker stands', and main then ran pane list 146 times, usually with gh pr list. Wanted: (1) the notice itself carries that worker's pane list row and its pull request's number and state, so main need not ask; (2) the final report the work-card skill (src/main/skills/work-card-skill.ts) asks a worker for is a short template (outcome, pull request, ids taken, caveats, anything needing the user's decision), with the detail on the pull request. Find the notice text under src/main/workers/.
